Purchases a store item using GAME_CURRENCY. Calculates the authoritative final price including offers and input discount vouchers (`voucherInstanceIds`). Ordinary items are granted as Store inventory and the response data is the granted `UserInventory[]` (unchanged contract). A Store item linked to a published VoucherDefinition (`VoucherDefinition.storeItemId`) is a voucher product: Wallet debit, purchase receipt and VoucherInstance issuance commit in one transaction and the response data is `VoucherProductPurchaseResponseDto`; no Store inventory is granted for it. The same Idempotency-Key with the same intent replays the committed result (no second charge or issuance); a different user, item, quantity, currency or discount-voucher set returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

item.name: Recover paid voucher purchases missing fulfillment (Admin)

request.description: Dry-run by default. Issues the missing VoucherInstances for completed, unrefunded voucher-product purchases using the definition/version that was on sale at purchase time (never the latest publication), retires the matching legacy Store inventory token units in the same transaction, and audits each repair. Ambiguous provenance is reported, not repaired. Idempotent and safe to re-run.

Reports paid voucher-product purchases missing VoucherInstances, STORE_PURCHASE instances without a purchase, refunded purchases with live vouchers, duplicate issuance ordinals, and inventory stackability inconsistencies. Never mutates state.
Unequips the item in the specified slot.

Consumes `quantity` (default 1) units with one conditional atomic decrement and returns `{ used, remaining }`; a row reaching 0 is removed. Allowed only when the owning Store item is stackable (StoreItem.isStackable is authoritative). Optional Idempotency-Key: the decrement and a durable use receipt commit together; the same key with the same inventoryId and quantity replays `{ used, remaining, replayed: true }` without consuming again, a different inventoryId/quantity returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Without the header each request is a new use. Never issues a VoucherInstance; legacy inventory of a voucher product is rejected with 409 VOUCHER_PRODUCT_INVENTORY_UNSUPPORTED.
